iti23:1.1: (Ek. III.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttamarahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti23:2.1: Ekadhammo bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ samparāyikañca. Katamo ekadhammo? Appamādo kusalesu dhammesu. Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave ekadhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ samparāyikañcā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti23:3.1: Appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti puññakiriyasu paṇḍitā | appamatto ubho atthe adhigaṇhāti paṇḍito ||
iti23:4.1: Diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho yo cattho samparāyiko | atthābhisamayā dhīro paṇḍito ti pavuccatīti ||
iti23:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||3||
